in_english.name: Nevio
in_english.meaning: gift of God or God is my gift, son of Nebius
in_english.long_meaning: Nevio is an uncommon Christian name derived from the Hebrew name Neviah, meaning 'gift of God' or 'God is my gift'. In biblical Hebrew, the name Neviah is mentioned in Ezra 2:55, Nehemiah 7:58, 1 Chronicles 4:34, and other places. In early Christian tradition, Nevio was used as a name for someone who received a spiritual gift or was known for their piety. In modern usage, Nevio is an uncommon name, but it has been used as a variant of Nebio or Nevia, which is associated with the biblical figure of Nebuzaradan, a Babylonian general who served under Nebuchadnezzar II.
